name: Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme
benefit: A pension of ₹ 300/- per month is provided to Widows between 40 years and 79 years. For persons who are 80 years and above, the pension is ₹ 500/- per month.
_eligibility_text: The eligibility criteria under Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme (IGNWPS) is: - The applicant must be a widow in the age group of 40-79 years. - The applicant should belong to a household living below the poverty line according to the criteria prescribed by the Govt. of India
